products.title: Large Classic Hoop Earrings
products.body_html:
Waterproof and 18K gold plated stainless steel. The hoop that started it all ✨ Bold but easy to wear, and made for people who never take their earrings off.

Size: 4cm diameter. A statement, but a relaxed one. Latch back, about 3.2g each.

12-month anti-tarnish warranty. Shower, gym, perfume, a wedding: all fine.

jewellery.care: Rinse and pat dry. Safe with water, sweat and perfume. Store in the pouch to avoid scratches.
